name: Rain tree
description: The Samanea saman dome over Richmond Town and Cubbon avenues. The workhorse — repeats most often without reading as a sticker.
placement: Anywhere green in the old city core.

name: Tabebuia in bloom
description: February pink on bare branches, petals drifting to the ground. Same silhouette family as the rain tree, a different season of the same city.

name: Gulmohar
description: The flat flame-tree umbrella, coral with marigold stamens and feathered leaves below.
placement: Long arterial stretches in the east.

name: Bamboo grove
description: Three culms with node ticks, borrowing the fern logic from the Reset icon. Reads as texture rather than object.

name: Kere
description: An irregular lake outline with reeds and one standing heron. Doubles as orientation when placed on real water.

name: Granite outcrop
description: Stacked Bengaluru gneiss in muted plum with a prickly pear at the base. Anchors the emptiest parts of the map.

name: Tech park
description: A stepped glass block with one coconut palm. The palm is what keeps it Bengaluru instead of Anytown.

name: Metro viaduct
description: A pier carrying the elevated deck with a train crossing it, so switching on the Metro layer feels connected to the artwork.
placement: Along the Purple and Green corridors.

name: Flower cart
description: Marigold garlands looped over a market pushcart. The one that makes people smile.

name: Parakeets
description: One rose-ringed parakeet and two distant flight marks. Punctuation more than illustration — never larger than 16px.
